label: Text 1
transcript: Lina spent a week at the seaside in Cornwall. The sea was cold even in August. Her cousin caught one tiny crab and released it three minutes later, looking slightly betrayed. Sam stayed home and finally cleaned his desk. The desk was deeply impressed. Both of them claim to have had the better holiday, with no clear winner.
